children.value: > Fact From Story: The indictment calls Bankman-Fried’s tweets in November 2022 “false and misleading.”
> > Fact From Story: If he wrote things on Twitter or said things in interviews that weren’t true, that’s more fodder for the government’s case.
> > > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried tweeted “FTX is fine. Assets are fine”.
> > > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried gave interviews freely.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: If someone says something untrue, that is evidence against them.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: What someone says is evidence about what they believe.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If someone says things that aren't true, that's evidence against them.
